assets.title: Platform and service prop atlas
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D scenery sprite atlas for Space Taxi: Frontier, matching detailed yellow taxi / astronaut arcade sprites. ONE square PNG, true transparent background. EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows of evenly spaced square cells, nine separate objects, no overlap, no grid or borders. Orthographic SIDE ELEVATION only, flat horizontal landing surfaces, never top down or isometric. Detailed polished painted pixel-art metal with dark navy outlines, weathering, bolts, bright cyan and amber details. Each object is centered with generous TRANSPARENT padding, no ground shadow, no words or letters. Row1: (1) long WIDE low-profile steel landing platform, straight top, cyan edge lights, landing deck and yellow black hazard stripes on front fascia, width roughly 270 height 45 inside cell; (2) same wide flat industrial rust orange platform with thick steel rivets and amber lamps, same proportions; (3) same wide flat organic alien purple-metal platform with turquoise luminous seams, same proportions. Row2: (4) upright futuristic GAS PUMP, amber and teal, bright cyan display with NO TEXT, visible thick coiled black fuel hose and nozzle on its side, little green indicator, complete object height 210 width 130; (5) short compact landing beacon lamp on foot, glowing amber glass, height100 width65; (6) compact upright cyan-screen passenger ticket terminal, metallic pedestal, no lettering, height150 width85. Row3: (7) vertical narrow steel truss support segment with X bracing and flat squared ends suitable for tiling vertically, height240 width55; (8) small red repair tool cabinet with wrench symbol and metal drawers, width160 height130; (9) upright blue industrial fuel canister with glowing green bands, metal piping, width100 height175. All sprites are complete isolated silhouettes, crisp edges and actual alpha transparency outside the objects. No scenery, no ships, no people, no labels, no watermark.
